rule: the four objects from runs/overfit_4obj_32k — the PLAN.md day-2 overfit gate, rendered in reports/overfit_render_overfit_4obj_32k.png. They are simply the first four names of the train split (train/overfit.py takes split['train'][:k]), so this file pins them explicitly rather than depending on that slicing staying put.
note: Two of the four are achromatic (chroma 0.001) — this set is a MEMORISATION demo, not a colour demo. experiments/names_colourful.json is the colour one.
